kabsa.description: Saudi Arabia's national dish with aromatic spiced rice and meat
steps: Boil chicken with onion, black lime, cardamom, and bay leaves for 30 minutes
Remove chicken and keep 4 cups of broth
Fry chicken until golden brown, set aside
In the same pot, sauté remaining onion and garlic until soft
Add tomatoes and kabsa spices, cook 5 minutes
Add rice and stir to coat with spices
Pour in 4 cups broth, bring to boil
Place chicken on top, cook 10 more minutes on low
tips: Use aged basmati rice for best texture
Don't skip resting time for fluffy rice

mandi.description: Smoky rice with tender meat - a feast favorite
steps: Marinate meat with spices for 1 hour
Boil meat with onion, garlic, spices until tender (1.5 hours)
Cook rice in the broth for 15 minutes
For smoking: place hot charcoal, drizzle oil, cover 5 minutes
Serve rice with meat on top
tips: Smoking step is optional but authentic
